capabilities: Publish notes marked with dg-publish: true to a GitHub repository and deployed site
Render Obsidian content (Dataview, Canvas, transclusions, callouts, MathJax, Mermaid, PlantUML) on the published site
Customize the site's styling, CSS variables, and Nunjucks template components
Export the garden to a local folder for self-hosting or preview
Update the site template via an automatically created pull request
extras: Setup takes about 10 minutes and requires creating a repository and a fine-grained GitHub token; Forestry.md managed hosting is described as being in open beta; local export performs a full export each time without publish status tracking or diffing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in free way to publish selected notes as a public website that the user fully controls and customizes.
